RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL  ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Wednesday,  the July 27, 2005/Sravana 5, 1927 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Commerce and Industry; Defence; Home Affairs;
Non-Conventional Energy Sources; Power; Rural
Development; Textiles)
Total number of questions — 20
Surrender policy of Government for
militants
*41. SHRI S.S. AHLUWALIA: Will the
Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be pleased
to state:
(a) the surrender policy of Government
for members of militant/terrorist outfits
who eschew violence and intend to return
to the mainstream civil society;
(b) whether it is uniform in all the
affected States or is at variance from one
State to another;
(c) whether distinctions, if any, are made
between surrendering members belonging
to outfits which have been operating at the
behest of or linked to foreign espionage
agencies and those who took to arms in
pursuance of extremist ideological doctrines
and/or to fight against policies of
Government perceived to be unjust;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) if not, the reasons therefor?
Threat of terrorist attacks
*42. SHRI ANAND SHARMA: Will
the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware of
the threat of terrorist attacks on national
monuments and temple townships; and
(b) the steps proposed to meet the
threat and protect places of national
importance and religious worship?
Inquiry points pertaining to SPS
*43. SHRI MOOLCHAND
MEENA:
DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Department of Commerce
has finalized three inquiry points pertaining
to Sanitary and Phyto-Sanitary (SPS)
measures  that would handle all queries or
comments on SPS notification/regulation
issued by other member countries of the
World Trade Organization;
(b) whether the three inquiry points
would be Department of Agriculture and
Cooperation for plant protection, Ministry
of Health for food safety and the
Department of Animal Husbandry and
Dairying for animal products; and
(c) if so, what is the outcome of the
steps taken in this regard?

14
Electricity shortage in the country
*44. PROF. ALKA BALRAM
KSHATRIYA:
DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
Will the Minister of POWER be pleased
to state:
(a) whether facing coal and gas shortage,
Government are now focusing on hydro
electricity for generating sustainable power
to tide over electricity shortage in the
country;
(b) whether Power Ministry are facing
coal and gas shortage for power plants;
(c) whether Minister has said that hydel
potential needed to be exploited for
electrifying all villages households by 2012;
and
(d) if so, what steps Government
propose to take to see that all villages are
electrified by 2012 and to what extent
Government have been able to achieve this
target?
Terrorist attack in Ayodhya
†*45. SHRIMATI SAVITA SHARDA:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that terrorists
recently attacked Ram Janm Bhumi in
Ayodhya;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the number of persons killed and
injured in the terrorist attack;
(d) whether any one has taken the
responsibility for the attack;
(e) if so, the details thereof;
(f) whether Government propose to
take stringent steps to prevent the
recurrence of such incidents; and
(g) if so, the details thereof?
Coordination in poverty alleviation
schemes
†*46. SHRI NAND KISHORE
YADAV: Will the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that for alleviating
poverty in rural areas of the country it is
necessary to remove unemployment;
(b) if so, whether it is also a fact that
many schemes are being run by
Government at present for providing
employment opportunities;
(c) whether it is also a fact that people
are not getting desired benefits of these
schemes in the absence of mutual
coordination among all the schemes; and
(d) if so, the details of corrective steps
Government propose to take for proper
implementation of the said schemes?
Indo-US MoU on military medicine
*47. SHRI GIREESH KUMAR
SANGHI:
DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether India and the United States
signed a MoU for training and academic
cooperation in military medicine that will
open up new frontiers in research and
education for armed forces of both the
countries;
(b) if so, the main aims and objects of
the MoU;
(c) to what extent US has agreed to help
and assist India in health and research in
the Army; and

RAJYA  SABHA

List of Questions for WRITTEN  ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Wednesday, the July 27, 2005/Sravana 5, 1927 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Commerce and Industry; Defence; Home Affairs; Non-
Conventional Energy Sources; Power; Rural Development; Textiles)
Total number of questions —105
Comprehensive Economic
Cooperation Agreement with
Singapore
229. SHRI LALIT SURI: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a
Comprehensive Economic Cooperation
Agreement was recently signed with the
Singapore Government;
(b) what will be the impact of this
Agreement on trading of items in the
Negative List like liquor, beer etc.; and
(c) what are the details thereof?
Import of cheap products
†230. SHRI MOTILAL VORA:
SHRIMATI PREMA
CARIAPPA:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
cheap products, which have heavy subsidy
from various developed countries are being
imported and dumped in the country;
(b) if so, whether Government have
formulated any strategy to check cheap
imports with a view to protecting the
interests of domestic industry and the
farmers;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor and by
when arrangements would be made
therefor?
Permission to visit Sharda Mata
Shrine
231. SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI: Will
the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Ministry
has received representations from
organisations of Kashmiri Pandit for
visiting Sharda Mata Shrine located in PoK;
(b) if so, the steps taken by the
Ministry in this regard;
(c) whether there is any possibility to
grant permission to Kashmiri Pandits for
visiting Sharda Mata Shrine in near future;
and
(d) if so, the timeframe thereof?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

53
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
India-Singapore MoU
232. SHRI MURLI DEORA: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether India and Singapore have
signed a Comprehensive Economic
Cooperation Agreement;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether the fears of Indian
companies about Chinese goods entering
India at concessional duty through
Singapore has been allayed and if so, the
safeguards adopted to protect the domestic
industry from third country imports; and
(d) the extent to which this MoU would
benefit India in boosting its trade?
Export of Alphanso Mango to China
†233. SHRI R.S. GAVAI: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
have permitted to export the 'alphanso'
variety of mango to China;
(b) whether it is also a fact that China
intend to import grapes, pomegranate, lady
finger, bitter gourd and other vegetables from
India;
(c) if so, whether Government are
contemplating on according its sanction for
the export thereof;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) if not, the reasons therefor?
Export of Alphanso Mangoes
†234. SHRI R.S. GAVAI: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Australia,
Japan, New Zealand and America have
expressed their intention to import Hapus
(Alphanso) mango which is somewhat
vapour heat treated;
(b) if so, whether Government are
contemplating to allow export of Hapus
mango to these countries;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?
Foreign investment in UP
†235. SHRI NAND KISHORE
YADAV: Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) the targets fixed for foreign
investment in Uttar Pradesh during the last
three years under the liberalisation policy
alongwith the achievements thereof;
(b) the targets fixed for the foreign
investment during the forthcoming five
years; and
(c) the steps taken by the Government
for achieving the target?
Industrial Development Centres in
the country
†236. SHRI NAND KISHORE
YADAV: Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) the total number of Industrial
Development Centres in the country as on
the last month and the number of Industrial

54
Development Centres in Uttar Pradesh out
of the above;
(b) the amount provided by the Central
Government to the Industrial Development
Centres of Uttar Pradesh during the last
three years; and
(c) the number of Industrial
Development Centres proposed to be set
up in this financial year alongwith the
locations thereof?
Made in India Exhibition in Lahore,
Pakistan

(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether it is also a fact that
Government of Pakistan has allowed only
exhibition of products to be displayed at
the expo, and not granted permission for
